title: SmartRecruiters posting row
description: One open posting from a SmartRecruiters board, read from the board's own public JSON.

status.title: Status
status.description: DELIVERED, NOT_CHECKED_BOARD_NOT_FOUND, NOT_CHECKED_BOARD_EMPTY, NOT_CHECKED_ERROR or INVALID_INPUT.

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: Industry label, for example Mining And Metals.

experienceLevel.title: Experience level
experienceLevel.description: Level label, for example Mid-Senior Level.

location.title: Location
location.description: Full location as the board builds it.

city.title: City
city.description: City when the board publishes one.

region.title: Region
region.description: Region or state when the board publishes one.

countryCode.title: Country code
countryCode.description: Uppercase ISO-2 code of the posting location.

address.title: Address
address.description: Street address when the board publishes one.

postalCode.title: Postal code
postalCode.description: Postal code when the board publishes one.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude when the board publishes one.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude when the board publishes one.

remote.title: Remote
remote.description: True when the board marks the posting remote, or its location says remote or anywhere.

hybrid.title: Hybrid
hybrid.description: True when the board marks the posting hybrid.

salaryMin.title: Salary, from
salaryMin.description: Lower bound when the employer publishes a salary, otherwise null.

salaryMax.title: Salary, to
salaryMax.description: Upper bound when the employer publishes a salary, otherwise null.

salaryPeriod.title: Salary period
salaryPeriod.description: Period when published, for example YEAR or MONTH.

jobDescription.title: Description
jobDescription.description: Job description text, only when includeDetails is on.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.description: Qualifications text, only when includeDetails is on.

additionalInformation.title: Additional information
additionalInformation.description: Benefits and notes, only when includeDetails is on.

companyDescription.title: Company description
companyDescription.description: Company blurb, only when includeDetails is on.

detailFetched.title: Description fetched
detailFetched.description: True when the description request succeeded.

applyUrl.title: Apply URL
applyUrl.description: Apply link the board publishes, only when includeDetails is on.

postingUrl.title: Posting URL
postingUrl.description: Posting link the board publishes, only when includeDetails is on.

detailError.title: Description error
detailError.description: Why the description could not be read. The posting is still delivered with its list data.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why this row is not a delivered posting.
